title: Abstraction
body:
***Control abstraction***
Seperation of logical properies of an action from its implementation

***Data Abstraction***
Checking [[Data type]] 
What type of data do we allow? You can hide this from the user.

Abstract Data Type Is a data type whose properties (domain and operations)
are specified  independendtly of any particular implementation.

***Information Hiding***
using Private and Public sections of your class
